summary: This tutorial covers basic text formatting in LibreOffice Writer, including aligning text, adding bullets and numbering, and using copy and paste functions. To align text, you can select the text and choose from align left, center, or justify. Bullets and numbering help organize points; to add them, go to the Format menu, then bullets and numbering, where you can choose different styles. For indentation, use tab and shift keys. Copy and paste can be done by selecting text, copying it, moving the cursor to the desired location, and pasting. Shortcuts for these actions are Ctrl+C for copy and Ctrl+V for paste. This tutorial demonstrates how to make documents more appealing and easier to read by applying these formatting techniques.
